_why: A mechanical caller sweep answers 'is anything wired to this?' — not 'can it actually run?'. These four have a caller that cannot fire. Each override names the gate that makes it so, and verify-arch-map.sh fails if that gate disappears from the source, so an override cannot outlive its own reason.

content-generator.reason: data-fetcher calls it only when the CONTENT_GENERATOR_ENABLED secret is the string "true", and it is not.

content-reviewer.reason: Only content-generator calls it, and that is gated off.

client-error-alert.reason: notification-sender does call it on an APNs auth failure, so it is NOT dormant — the map said so and was wrong. But dev_alert_devices is empty, so every alert it sends reaches nobody. It recorded a 93% cron HTTP failure on 2026-09-20 and told no one.

team-page-generator.reason: data-fetcher calls it through triggerFunction(), which a functions/v1 grep misses. Live in dynamic_only mode; full mode is manual and bills the paid API.
